issues.description: Bid protest merits: the omissions were material, could not be cured by clarification or waiver, and the Government did not abuse its discretion in declining to clarify or waive them, so the protest is denied.
issues.quote: The Claims Court did not commit any of the four errors alleged by Safeguard on appeal.

issues.description: Trial and case management: denial of Safeguard's request to supplement the administrative record with affidavits and depositions was not an abuse of discretion.
issues.quote: the Claims Court did not abuse its discretion by denying Safeguard's email request and separate motion to supplement the administrative record.
